description: left profile of a stocky bearded Three Kingdoms infantryman, black and red armor and a red headband, one dark spear with a single wavy silver blade and gold butt cap
action: Grounded intimidation shout, not an attack. Inhale, stamp the left boot once sideways (anatomical left), open the chest and raise the bent empty left fist. Right hand holds the same single upright spear with butt grounded. Keep head and torso proportions fixed throughout. No elongation of chest, neck, waist or limbs at any time. Ease back to the exact original neutral silhouette, same armor, shape, scale and colors. Follow the supplied rig and headband and cloth lag. Transparent background, no effects. Keep the original eyes open, eyebrows, face width and beard. At the shout peak only (poses 6–7), briefly open the mouth modestly as if giving a loud shout; close by pose 9. No grin, blink, oversized mouth, enlarged jaw, new teeth or whole-face redesign. Keep strict left profile. The left foot moves sideways toward the camera in depth, not forward along screen x.
